# imuMAP: Immunity: Mapping, Aggregation, and Projection

> ⚠️ **Under construction.** Tools for geospatial mapping, spatial
> aggregation, and re-projecting vaccination coverage estimates onto new
> spatial organizations and scales.

A sibling R package to [`imuGAP`](https://github.com/ACCIDDA/imuGAP)
providing geospatial mapping, spatial aggregation across hierarchies,
re-projecting coverage estimates onto alternative
administrative/geographic scales, and cartographic visualizations.

## What’s here today

A thin wrapper around `imuGAP::imuGAP()` packaged as a shell CLI:

- [`install_cli()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/install_cli.md)
  — drops a symlink in `~/.local/bin` so `imugap` is on PATH.
- `inst/scripts/imugap.R` — the script the symlink points at. Reads
  `observations.{csv,rds}`, `populations.{csv,rds}`,
  `locations.{csv,rds}` from an input directory, runs imuGAP’s
  canonicalize + sampler, writes `fit.rds` (a raw stanfit) to the output
  directory.

Usage:

``` sh
imugap input/ output/
```

That’s it. No post-processing, no aggregation, no geospatial functions.

## What might land here later

A few directions have been discussed; none are committed:

- Post-processing helpers that turn a stanfit into the tabular shapes
  downstream consumers (e.g. the [measles
  dashboard](https://github.com/ACCIDDA/measles-dashboard)) need.
- Geospatial joins between school-level model output and standardized
  location data from
  [USImmunityProfiles](https://github.com/ACCIDDA/USImmunityProfiles).
- CLI subcommands beyond “run the model.”

We expect the scope to firm up as the dashboard’s CSV consumption work
([measles-dashboard#20](https://github.com/ACCIDDA/measles-dashboard/issues/20))
and the broader release prep on imuGAP land.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("ACCIDDA/imuMAP")
```

Requires imuGAP, which is currently a GitHub-only dependency (declared
under `Remotes:` in `DESCRIPTION`). Once imuGAP is on CRAN that line can
go away.

## Repository status

- CI: Automated testing via GitHub Actions. R-CMD-check + pkgdown run on
  every PR; `man/` is regenerated from roxygen comments in CI and is not
  tracked in git.
- Issues and discussion are tracked in [the issue
  tracker](https://github.com/ACCIDDA/imuMAP/issues).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`allocate()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/allocate.md)
  : Re-project / Allocate Coverage Estimates Across Spatial Units
- [`calc_allocation_weights()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/calc_allocation_weights.md)
  : Calculate Spatial Allocation Weights Matrix
- [`calc_distance_matrix()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/calc_distance_matrix.md)
  : Compute Pairwise Distance Matrix with Optional Eligibility Filtering
- [`canonicalize_demographics()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/canonicalize_demographics.md)
  : Canonicalize Sink Demographic Data
- [`canonicalize_spatial()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/canonicalize_spatial.md)
  : Canonicalize Spatial Source and Sink Geometries
- [`dim(`*`<imumap_dist_matrix>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/dim.imumap_dist_matrix.md)
  : Dimension of Distance Matrix
- [`dim(`*`<imumap_weights>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/dim.imumap_weights.md)
  : Dimensions of Allocation Weights
- [`eligibility_rule()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/eligibility_rule.md)
  : Define Spatial Eligibility Rule
- [`eligibility_rules()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/eligibility_rules.md)
  : Bundle Multiple Eligibility Rules
- [`imumap_options()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/imumap_options.md)
  : Configure imuMAP Execution Options
- [`install_cli()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/install_cli.md)
  : Install imuGAP CLI to PATH
- [`kernel_options()`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/kernel_options.md)
  : Create Distance Decay Kernel Options
- [`print(`*`<imumap_dist_matrix>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/print.imumap_dist_matrix.md)
  : Print Distance Matrix Summary
- [`print(`*`<imumap_eligibility_rule>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/print.imumap_eligibility_rule.md)
  : Print Eligibility Rule Summary
- [`print(`*`<imumap_kernel_options>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/print.imumap_kernel_options.md)
  : Print Kernel Options Summary
- [`print(`*`<imumap_options>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/print.imumap_options.md)
  : Print imuMAP Options Summary
- [`print(`*`<imumap_weights>`*`)`](https://accidda.github.io/imuMAP/reference/print.imumap_weights.md)
  : Print Allocation Weights Summary
